inputs.original_text: Revelation was included in lawsuit challenging practice of targeting people seeking to gain legal status as they leave immigration courts Sign up for the Breaking News US email to get newsletter alerts in your inbox Lawyers for ICE provided false information to justify arresting and detaining thousands of people who had attended immigration courts, according to newly filed court documents. Federal prosecutors said that lawyers for ICE acknowledged that an agency memo from May of last year gave no authorization for the arrests, court documents show , despite previously citing it to justify the arrests. Continue reading...
inputs.modified_text: I just got information about a lawsuit exposing how ICE lawyers fed false information to justify rounding up and detaining thousands of people after they went to immigration courts. They kept using that agency memo from May of last year as cover, but the documents admit it gave no authorization at all. This is all coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions to target anyone trying to gain legal status right when they walk out of those courts. That sudden admission in the filing is just another layer of narrative control, designed to make it look like an isolated mistake while the real operation keeps running under the surface. They always invert the story this way to hide the bigger pattern from the public.
